text:
leah: Heads-up: provisioning delays hit a batch of trial accounts over the weekend (created 2026-11-05 -> 2026-11-07). Seeing ~18 trials affected; a subset are high-touch. Im putting together customer comms + a remediation offer.

omar: Can we confirm which customers are high-touch? Ill loop AEs.

leah: High-touch: NovaLabs, BrightFeed, QuillWorks, BlueHarbor. Full list in our sheet - https://redwood.internal/cs/provisioning-impacted-2026-11

carmen: Quick RCA note from infra: an autoscaling hiccup caused late delivery of provisioning webhooks, which then caused retries to pile up and a worker to stall on an exclusive index lock. Devs pushed a fix and a replay tool that processed the backlog.

ops-bot: deploy: hotfix/2026-11-08-index-retry-fix deployed by @omar at 2026-11-08T04:12Z :rocket:

leah: Thanks. Need decisions: credit proposal, whether to proactively escalate renewal-risk customers to AE + CS execs, and scheduling a walkthrough office hours session for impacted customers.

isabel: My recommendation: 20% credit on the next billing period for trials that failed provisioning for >12 hours, plus a 30-min 1:1 migration review for the top 4 high-touch. Also schedule a 45-min office hours the week after patch so customers can ask technical Qs.

carmen: Agree on credit + 1:1 for high-touch. Also propose we add a monitoring alert to catch index lock duration > 5s and trigger an auto-restart of the worker to limit impact.

sales-ops: From renewal perspective, flag NovaLabs + BrightFeed as high risk; I'll notify the AE owners and prepare tailored outreach scripts. We should offer a dedicated follow-up call with CS + AE.

leah: Good. Carmen, can you give me a one-paragraph RCA I can paste into an email? Keep it customer-facing, avoid internal jargon.

carmen: Draft for email: "We experienced a temporary delay in provisioning for a small set of trial accounts due to an unexpected backlog in our provisioning queue which led to delayed setup of customer indexes. Our team deployed a fix, processed the backlog, and verified that affected accounts are now provisioned. Were implementing additional safeguards and improved monitoring to prevent this from happening again."

leah: Nice. Add an explicit apology sentence and an offer for 1:1 help for the high-touch customers, then Ill send it.

isabel: Also note in the email that well apply the credit automatically, and invite them to the office hours link + include the RSVP form.

leah: Action items: carmen  final email copy + credit mechanics by EOD; isabel  schedule office hours + RSVP form + calendar invites; omar  confirm replay/backfill completion timestamp and post here; sales-ops  flag renewal risk in SF and ping AEs.

omar: Backfills at 60% now, ETA ~1.25h. If any account still missing index after that, Ill trigger manual replay.

leah: If backfill slips, we escalate to the oncall and offer extended credit window + optional single-tenant migration help. Carmen/isabel please coordinate handoffs.

sales-ops: AE owners notified for NovaLabs and BrightFeed. Draft outreach template uploaded to shared doc.

leah: Thank you all. Once the backfill is complete Ill publish the customer note and well follow-up with the high-touch 1:1 invites.
